audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers gave opposite verdicts on all seven rows: full said Lissandra 8/10 HARD on every row, content win[0..6] said Fizz on every row, and the prose on each side argued the opposite of the other.
audit.why: The kit backs the full layer. Ring of Frost is an instant, point-blank 450-range root on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 — the exact answer to a 550-range Urchin Strike walk-up — and Frozen Tomb cast on herself makes her untargetable and invulnerable while healing, which answers the level 6 shark-plus-string. The 49.44% win rate over 4426 games agrees that Fizz is not favoured. The packet levelChart (all Fizz) matches the content layer but not the kit.
audit.corrected: Content win[0..6] moved to Lissandra as one atomic group, matching the existing full-layer sides; whys[0..6] and phases[0..6].why rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content spikes and mid/late text sold level 6 and first item as clean Fizz windows.
audit.why: Frozen Tomb is 120/100/80 and available from 6; self-cast it is untargetable, invulnerable and a heal. A shark plus full string lands on nothing if she has it up.
audit.corrected: Spikes 1-3 and mid/late rewritten around baiting the 120s ultimate and bringing Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were absent: Ring of Frost has no travel time to dodge, and Frozen Tomb's self-cast is untargetable AND invulnerable AND a heal.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them' (450 range, instant) and 'If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable'. Grounding on Playful/Trickster and Chum the Waters does shut off Glacial Path (1050 range, 24/21/18/15/12), which is the one lever in your favour.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, trading, dos/donts, carry and late now state all three.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance despite Frozen Tomb healing her.
audit.why: The 'needs-antiheal' rule applies to this matchup.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into spikes[2], late and wants.you[2].

edits.after: Level 6 does not flip this lane the way it flips others: Chum the Waters grounds Glacial Path, but Frozen Tomb cast on herself is untargetable, invulnerable and a heal, so a shark plus full string can land on nothing. edits.before: Once Lissandra has her core items, Frozen Tomb becomes a genuine threat that can punish a careless all-in or peel for her team, so you need to respect the cooldown and bait it before committing fully. Bring Grievous Wounds, and hunt her only when she is away from her team.

notes:
This matchup's two layers argued opposite verdicts on all seven rows (full: Lissandra 8/10 on every row; content win[]: Fizz on every row), so one side had to move. I moved the content layer onto the full layer because the kit supports it — an instant point-blank 450 root and an untargetable/invulnerable self-cast ultimate are the two things Fizz cannot play around — and because 49.44% over 4426 games does not describe a lane Fizz wins at every stage. The packet levelChart (all Fizz) agrees with the content layer and not with the kit; I did not treat it as authoritative here. Ratings left at 7/10 throughout rather than invent a new scale.
